R4 OldScan spec: arms A0 none / A1 deskew+Otsu / A2 deskew+Sauvola / A3 DocRes pilot (n<=8); adopt iff median dCER <= -0.03, 95% bootstrap CI excl 0, >=2/3 frozen engines, no dot/matra regression, CPU <=60 s (classical). Status: designed, never run; no labelled old-scan slice exists.

Restoration evidence is Latin-only (PreP-OCR -63.9..-70.3% CER on 13,831 historical English/French/Spanish pages; DIBCO Latin/Greek). Super-resolution helped low-res but hurt high-res (87.44 vs 88.13). Judged likely net-negative for Nastaliq; must be conditional and gated.

R2 Nastaliq recipe: QARI (Qwen2-VL-2B) CER 0.550 -> 0.061 on 50k pure-synthetic lines; UTRSet synth-only 75.14% vs real-trained 90.87% (15-pt residual) so add 300-500 real ks lines. B-03 gate: ks CER <=0.20 on held-out real lines, abort >0.30. CTC fails Nastaliq (needs autoregressive decoder).

4-bit hurts Arabic-script: QARI CER 3.45 at 4-bit vs 0.091 at 8-bit (B-01 bans 4-bit for ks/ur/sd unless within 1 CER pt). Bodhan Gate 1 4-bit vs bf16 is near-identical overall (sample-100 0.6878 vs 0.6863; pair-only 0.4034 vs 0.4010) but not tested on Perso-Arabic.

Up to 3-8 pts of ks/ur/sd CER may be a scoring artefact (NFKC, yeh/kaf variants, digits, punctuation, LRI/PDI bidi isolates). B-02: opt-in normalize_arabic module, default metrics.py stays locked, report raw AND normalized; gate = reduces CER gap >=3 pts.

GlotOCR attributes low-tier failure to script-level pretraining coverage, not font availability; the 'fonts are the constraint' framing is suggestive only. Synthetic-only caps CER (Nayana 0.227 vs Tesseract 0.206); synthetic scores do not predict real-scan rank; synth is a gate, never eval.
